scenarios.name: Write failure (write-conflict) surfaces error + retry path

assertions.label: raw Markdown editor is open
UI checksum matches the host checksum
write-conflict error text is visible
assertions.detail: ["! 写入冲突：该文件已在磁盘上被其他程序修改，为避免覆盖，插件拒绝写入。请先重新读取。 重新读取"]

assertions.label: a retry (重新读取) path is offered
editor content is preserved after the failure
host returns write-conflict for the stale checksum
assertions.detail: {"code":"write-conflict","message":"文件已被其他程序修改，为避免覆盖您的编辑，本次写入被拒绝。请重新载入后再保存。","detail":"<repo>\\.scratch\\ui3-home\\vault\\DSH Memory\\Knowledge\\种子记忆 Alpha-mem_20261017t090946_66649da5.md"}

assertions.label: 重新读取 refreshes the editor from disk
checksum refreshes after an index sync
write succeeds after the index is synced
host checksum matches the UI checksum after the write
the in-section raw edit is preserved exactly once

defects.summary: After an external disk edit, the UI retry path (重新读取) cannot resolve a write-conflict: readRaw returns the stale index checksum, so the next 写入文件 fails again. Only syncIndex/rebuildIndex updates the checksum, and the conflict message only tells the user to reload.

errorsAfterSecondWrite: ! 写入冲突：该文件已在磁盘上被其他程序修改，为避免覆盖，插件拒绝写入。请先重新读取。 重新读取

observations.summary: Raw Markdown saves are parsed and re-rendered: text a user adds outside the recognised sections is silently dropped, although the tab is labelled 原文 Markdown and its hint says it edits the file on disk directly. No warning is shown.

evidence.appended: 尾部附加内容（原文保真性探针）。

notes: D1: reload refreshes content but not the checksum; the retry fails until the index is synced.
